title: Test gaps in the source change report before a registered check
outcome: The report before a registered check (src/engram_report_before_check.rs) has tests for the paths its review rounds found unpinned, so a later change to the close or the scope can't break them silently.
acceptance: A Claude foreground launcher's test runs through the close: no source change at close after an accepted report, and a parallel foreground Bash edit after registration is reported from the moved baseline.
claude_session_work_restricts is pinned by a case that doesn't also mark the trace uncertain.
A real close during a report is driven, asserting the close's baseline stands and what both report.
An audit-only receipt, an invalid receipt after the send, and a minimum budget before the send each have a test.
a_report_inside_its_share_takes_no_time_from_registration is renamed to what it spends (past the fence, inside fence and share), and a spend at the share has a test.
